_note: Core book, Amp Types (pp. 58-60) and Shadow Amp Base Rating table (p. 61). An Amp's rating = baseRating + its effects' costs; each rating point costs 5,000¥.

quality.label: Quality
quality.description: Integral capability, always available. The character's first Quality (racial ones aside) has base rating 0; later ones 3. Bought only at creation or after a major event, but can be upgraded later.

awakened.label: Awakened
awakened.description: Grants magical capabilities; its rating is the sum of the abilities taken (astral perception, sorcery, conjuring, adept...). Gives no other enhancements.

cyberware.label: Cyberware
cyberware.description: One cybernetic implant. Readily available, but can be hacked or restrained.

bioware.label: Bioware
bioware.description: One biological implant. Less Essence loss and can't be hacked, but more limited and pricier than cyberware.

adept-power.label: Adept Power
adept-power.description: Magic channeled into the body. Requires the Awakened Amp with the Adept ability; affected by background count.

equipment.label: Equipment
equipment.description: Turns an item the character already bought into an Amp so it can take effects. Cheap and no Essence loss, but the most likely to be lost or jammed.

cyberdeck.label: Cyberdeck
cyberdeck.description: Required to hack the Matrix (the Cracking Skill).

vehicle.label: Vehicle or Drone
vehicle.description: A vehicle or drone built from one of the base types in vehicleTypes.json.

contact.label: Contact
contact.description: A named individual in the character's network.
